name: Runaway Bay Saturday Challenge 2022
information:
This is a series competition alongside [Runaway Bay Sunday Challenge 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RunawayBaySundayChallenge2022) . You will be permitted to compete at **ONLY ONE** of the two competitions. If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events.
